caseName: Armistead v. Associated General Contractors of California
caseNameFull: Armistead v. Associated General Contractors of California City of Los Angeles v. Associated General Contractors of California Los Angeles County v. Associated General Contractors of California Klutznick, Secretary of Commerce v. Associated General Contractors of California and National Association for the Advancement of Colored People, Los Angeles Branch v. Associated General Contractors of California

opinions.text:
Appeals from D. C. C. D. Cal. Judgment vacated and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Fullilove v. Klutznick, ante, p. 448.

Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. Justice Rehnquist, and Mr. Justice Stevens would affirm the judgment.

Reported below: 459 F. Supp. 766.
